run_experiment: run a BenchMARL multi-agent RL experiment with MAPPO on the VMAS BALANCE task
configure_experiment_config: load an ExperimentConfig from YAML and override learning rate, evaluation mode, and training device
load_vmas_task: load a VMAS task config from YAML using VmasTask.BALANCE.get_from_yaml
load_mappo_config: load a MAPPO algorithm config from YAML using MappoConfig.get_from_yaml
create_experiment: create an Experiment instance with task, algorithm, model configs and a seed then run it
